name: adapt_reactive_config_typescript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time greeter.ts's own text contains 'Hello' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt) instead of a fixed prompt count, then config.ts's NAME changes under it
prompts: config.ts exports a const NAME. Create greeter.ts that exports a function greet(): string returning `Hello, ${NAME}!`, importing NAME from './config' (do not copy or hardcode its value).
config.ts's NAME may have changed since you last checked it. Make sure greet() still returns a string built from the CURRENT value of NAME, not a stale or hardcoded one.

disruptions.description: config.ts's NAME changed World -> Universe, triggered reactively once greeter.ts's first draft appeared (not a fixed step count)

check_command: tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build config.ts greeter.ts test_greeter.ts && node build/test_greeter.js
